Upcoming & Events

🥇Our university's tagline is where talent meets opportunity, and it brings us immense joy to announce that three of our university students have been selected for the UGC NEP SAARTHI Scheme.

This prestigious scheme has chosen students from only 271 higher education institutes across the country🇮🇳, and we are proud that SSSUTMS students are among those selected for UGC NEP SAARTHI.

This is a significant placement and career opportunity for our university students.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to Vice Chancellor Sir  🙏for his guidance and support, & we express our sincere thanks to every member of the university.😊🙏🏻
————
NEP SAARTHI (Student Ambassador for Academic Reforms in Transforming Higher Education in India) is a UGC initiative that allows students to become ambassadors, raising awareness about the National Education Policy (NEP) and providing an opportunity to build their careers while contributing to the nation's educational transformation."

भारत के 271 हायर एजुकेशन इंस्टिट्यूट में (IIT, NIT, Autonomous, Private university, other college में) हमारी University के 3 Students को UGC NEP SAARATHI scheme में select कर लिया गया है.

📢 Sri Satya Sai University of Technology & Medical Sciences, Sehore (M.P.) is organizing an Expert Talk on
🔐 Cyber Security and Digital Forensics

🗓 Date: 20th August 2025
⏰ Time: 11:00 AM – 12:30 PM
📍 Venue: Shri Harwansh Lal Chopda Auditorium, SSSUTMS Campus, Sehore.

👤 Expert Speaker:
Mr. Vijay Kumar Jhingran
Vice President, International College of Security Studies (ICSS)

🎓 Advisor: Dr. Mukesh Tiwari, Hon’ble Vice Chancellor, SSSUTMS, Sehore.

✅ E-Certificate will be provided to all participants.
👥 All students and faculties of the University can attend this Expert Talk.

🌐 Why Attend?
In today’s digital era, every profession—engineering, medical, management, law, pharmacy, agriculture, or humanities—depends on technology and data.

Cyber Security protects your research, identity, finances, and personal data from online threats.

Digital Forensics helps in detecting, investigating, and preventing cybercrimes, ensuring trust and safety in every field.

For both students and faculties, knowledge of cyber security builds digital awareness, professional safety, and future career opportunities.

✨ Don’t miss this chance to learn how Cyber Security & Digital Forensics are shaping the future of every profession!

CELEBRATION OF NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY 2026

Dear Students and Faculty,

Sri Satya Sai University of Technology & Medical Sciences, Sehore, catalysed and supported by the M.P. Council of Science & Technology (MPCST), Bhopal, is organizing a grand celebration of National Science Day 2026.

The Organizing Committee invites you to join us as we commemorate the revolutionary contributions of Sir C. V. Raman and explore the wonders of science through engaging competitions and events.

Events:
* Inauguration Ceremony – 28 February 2026, 10:30 AM, CIDC Seminar Hall
* Three Expert Sessions
* Scientific Rangoli (Top Female Scientists in India)
* Scientific Poster Presentation (Top Female Scientists in India)
* Scientific Model Exhibition
* Scientific Reel-Making Competition
* Valedictory Ceremony

What’s in it for Students?
* Attractive prizes for winners
* Certificates for all participants
* A valuable opportunity to showcase your talent and innovation

Do not miss this scientific extravaganza. Let us innovate and inspire.

Program Coordinator:
Dr. Geeta Khoobchandani
and all Members of the Organizing Committee
Sri Satya Sai University of Technology & Medical Sciences, Sehore
